model.controlled_space: L^2(0,L) x H^{-1}(0,L) by L^2 Dirichlet control at x=L

nonclaims: the finite modal receipt is not a proof of infinite-dimensional observability
HUM and the geometric control mechanism are not claimed as new
a revival and source Laplacian are not a target determinant or Hilbert-Polya operator

proof_contract.finite_role: exact cells audit constants and conventions but do not prove infinite-dimensional observability
proof_contract.missed_arc: if cT<2L, support a nonzero smooth mean-zero F' in the complementary arc
proof_contract.revival_phases: all nonzero modes have frequencies n*pi*c/L and common gcd one

references.title: Exact Controllability, Stabilization and Perturbations for Distributed Systems

references.authors: Claude Bardos, Gilles Lebeau, and Jeffrey Rauch
references.title: Sharp Sufficient Conditions for the Observation, Control, and Stabilization of Waves from the Boundary
references.venue: SIAM Journal on Control and Optimization 30(5), 1024-1065 (1992)

theorem_contract.boundary: no zero mode; endpoint reversal, T=0, half revival, and all positive L,c scalings are explicit
theorem_contract.hum: duality gives exact L2 Dirichlet boundary control on the transposition state space at exactly the same threshold
theorem_contract.observability: one-end observability holds for every T>=2L/c, equality included
theorem_contract.revival: the least positive full-energy wave-group identity time is 2L/c
theorem_contract.short_time_failure: every T<2L/c misses a nonzero smooth periodic traveling profile
